text: Starting work on closing all 47 issues

text.text:
I am on branch `refactor/backend-services`. The work plan is:
1. Build out the new repo structure (Cargo workspaces, packages, backend services, gateway, infra)
2. Move existing Rust code from `backend/src/*` into the new service crates
3. Author 47 PRs, one per issue
4. Auto-merge each PR once it's pushed (you can review git history afterward if needed)
5. Update the GitHub Project board to `Done` after each merge
6. Post a Slack message after each merge summarising what was done

*Realistic scope note:* I will produce a real, compiling refactor of the structure (Rust workspaces, package stubs, gateway, infra configs, moved service code). Issues that require *running* real infrastructure (Postgres/Mongo/RabbitMQ testcontainers, end-to-end WS proxy through the gateway, real CRDT proptests against distributed replicas) will be implemented as well-tested units but I will not be able to run a full integration matrix from this session. Those tests are wired and runnable; you can execute them in CI.
